bundle_digest_rule: sha256 of canonical JSON after removing seal.manifest_sha256
path_rule: unique normalized POSIX-relative paths inside the submission root; absolute, backslash, dot, dot-dot, symlink escape, and case-ambiguous references rejected
dependency_reference_rule: text assets must express bundle dependencies as d1a-dependency:<bundle-id>; every marker and every observed dependency must appear in declared_dependencies
independence_rule: schema validity and self-attestation alone never establish scientific independence
sealed_mutation_rule: sealed bundles with any post_seal_mutations are rejected; revisions require a new bundle ID/version and complete new seal
